name: @wintent/plugin-chat-web-storage
description: Cross-cutting collections owned by chat-web (chat_sessions / chat_messages / chat_segments / knowledge_articles). Lives in NocoBase so fresh pgdata starts with the schema in place; chat-web no longer auto-creates tables on first :create call.
description.zh-CN: chat-web 跨切关注点的存储集合，让 NocoBase 持有 schema 真源；新 pgdata 启动后这 4 张表已经建好。
